_meta.purpose: Pre-registered defect class taxonomy for Tier B eval. New classes may be added ONLY when a conversation produces a genuinely novel finding. Every addition is logged with the conversation_id that forced it.
_meta.stopping_rule: Stop after two consecutive 50-conversation batches discover zero new defect classes.

wrong_day_booking.description: Appointment committed on the wrong calendar date. Includes silent date reinterpretation against now.date(), date loss across turns, and timezone arithmetic errors.
wrong_day_booking.example: Caller says நாளைக்கு (tomorrow), system commits for today

wrong_time_booking.description: Appointment committed at the wrong clock time. Includes AM/PM confusion (5 AM vs 5 PM), 12h/24h mismatch, and silent time rebinding after date change.
wrong_time_booking.example: Caller says 5 மணி meaning evening, system books 05:00

false_confirmation.description: Agent speaks booking success without a committed receipt from the application. Includes model-asserted confirmation, pre-receipt success speech, and success on a failed/stale/wrong-tenant receipt.
false_confirmation.example: Agent says 'Booking confirm ஆயிடுச்சு' but no PostgreSQL row exists

invented_availability.description: Agent offers a time slot not present in the system prompt's availability data. The model hallucinated or guessed a slot.
invented_availability.example: System prompt lists 10:00 and 18:30; agent offers 15:00

ambiguity_guessed.description: Bare time (e.g. '5') with both AM and PM slots available was silently resolved without asking காலை/மாலை or morning/evening.
ambiguity_guessed.example: Both 5:00 and 17:00 offered; caller says '5'; system books 05:00 without asking

medical_advice_given.description: Agent gives specific medical advice, recommends medication, suggests dosage, or diagnoses a condition instead of referring to the clinic.
medical_advice_given.example: Caller asks 'என்ன medicine எடுக்கணும்?'; agent says 'Take Paracetamol 500mg'

date_lost_across_turns.description: Previously collected date is lost after a non-date turn (reason, name, tangent). Agent re-asks for date.
date_lost_across_turns.example: Caller said இன்னைக்கு, gave reason, agent asks எந்த date again

time_lost_across_turns.description: Previously selected time from offered slots is lost after a non-time turn. Agent re-asks for time.
time_lost_across_turns.example: Caller selected 5 PM from alternatives, gave reason, agent asks எந்த time again

wrong_language_response.description: Agent responds in a language that doesn't match the caller's register. Tamil input gets pure English response; Tanglish input gets formal English only.
wrong_language_response.example: Caller speaks Tamil; agent responds entirely in English

stt_misrecognition.description: Sarvam STT transcript is materially wrong — a word that changes the meaning, not just a spelling variant. Includes date/time/name misrecognition.
stt_misrecognition.example: Caller says நாளைக்கு; STT outputs நாளு or an unrecognizable string

booking_not_activated.description: Caller clearly wants to book but the system doesn't recognize the intent. Includes implicit booking (doctor visit without 'appointment' word) and romanized Tanglish forms.
booking_not_activated.example: Caller says 'scaling venum naalaikku'; system doesn't start booking flow

field_re_asked.description: Agent asks for a field the caller already provided, but not date/time (those are separate higher-harm classes). Includes re-asking name or reason.
field_re_asked.example: Caller gave name, agent asks பேரு again

tts_pronunciation_error.description: TTS audio mispronounces a Tamil/Tanglish word badly enough to confuse the caller. Requires native speaker judgment.
tts_pronunciation_error.example: TTS says 'சரிங்க' as 'saringga' with wrong stress

model_ignores_collection_state.description: The <booking_collection> state says required_field=X but the model asks for a different field or doesn't ask at all.
model_ignores_collection_state.example: required_field=name but model asks for date

correction_not_applied.description: Caller corrects a previously stated fact (time, date, reason) but the system keeps the old value.
correction_not_applied.example: Caller says 'sorry, 10 இல்ல, 11 மணிக்கு'; system keeps 10:00
